statement: For every p in {1,2,3,4,5}, with gamma_D=5p(p+1) and a^(2)_{kappa,gamma} interpreted exactly as in source.md and problem.md, Gamma_p=sup_{0<kappa<1} inf{gamma>0 : a^(2)_{kappa,gamma} is positive semidefinite}=1/[p(4p+5)]. Thus the exact values for p=1,2,3,4,5 are respectively 1/9, 1/26, 1/51, 1/84, and 1/125. For each p there is no maximizing kappa in (0,1); the supremum is attained only as the one-sided limit kappa->0+, while kappa->1- is not a limiting maximizer. Consequently the paper's vanishing-cut necessary threshold is globally sharp in all five requested degrees.
contribution: This resolves the frozen five-degree classification. Exact completions of squares reduce the global upper bound to rational-polynomial Schur matrices. Fraction-free leading-minor certificates prove positive semidefiniteness at the proposed weights on the full cut interval, and an exact rank-one endpoint criterion proves necessity and the complete maximizer classification.
